description: Liiklusjärelevalve infosüsteem is a dataset listed in Data information gateway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Kliimaministeerium. The purpose of the traffic supervision information system is the electronic storage, systematisation and exchange of data collected in the course of road transport and traffic supervision and the preparation of reports and analyses on the basis of such data. Coverage: Kliimaministeerium. The portal shows the English title as "Traffic supervision information system" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Kliimaministeerium. Its keywords include lorries, veoautod, traffic police control, autojuhid, liiklusjärelevalve, car drivers. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-avaandmete-portaal.
